name: Scene Dissolve and Constant-Power Audio Crossfade
allowable_alternatives: Using opacity keyframes and audio volume gain envelopes to approximate the transition manually (Acceptable Alternative, Missed Built-In Capability)
diagnostic_traps: Placing both overlapping clips on the same track, triggering E-TRACK-OVERLAP
Attempting linear volume fading instead of constant-power curve resulting in an audio perceived volume dip during the crossfade
